sentences.text:
Arnab Sen & Ors vs Unknown on 22 December, 2025
22.12.2025
 Court No.34
 Item.22
 sg
 Crr 4786 of 2023

In the matter of: Arnab Sen & Ors
 ...Petitioner
 Mr. Arindam Jana
 Ms. Jhuma Sen
 Ms. Swastika Chatterjee
 Mr. Yuvraj Chatterjee
 ...for the petitione
 Mr. Shambhu Nath Roy
 Ms. Munmun Das
 Ms. Afreen Parvez
 ...for the de-facto complainant.
 Ms. Anasuya Sinha
 Ms. Sima Biswas ...for the State.
 Re. : Cran 1 of 2025
 1.
Affidavit of service filed by the petitioner be kept on record.

2.  This matter is taken up for hearing and in course of hearing it is submitted by the learned advocate representing the petitioners that CRAN 1 of 2025 is filed for stay of all further proceedings since date is fixed on 19th January, 2026 for appearance and also for Execution of warrant.
3. It is submitted on 31st July, 2025 they could not appear before the court, warrant of arrest was issued against present petitioners including the parents-in-law and maternal uncle and other in-laws only the husband who attended the said date.

Accordingly learned Judge passed an order for issuing warrant of arrest against the petitioners nos. 2,3,4 and 5.
4.

Learned advocate appearing for the opposite party no.2 raises strong objection and submits an order of stay is granted, consequence will be high prejudiced, matter pertaining to quash of complaint under Section 498A/307 of the Indian Penal Code.
It further transpire that numerous litigations are pending between the parties.

5. However, matter is taken up for hearing and heard-in-part and date is fixed for further hearing on Arnab Sen & Ors vs Unknown on 22 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131785017/
1 19th January, 2026 and also in pursuance of the direction of the Coordinate Bench of this Court report has not yet been submitted by the learned prosecutor.
6. This Court is of the view order of interim stay be granted for a limited period.
Accordingly,proceeding pending before the learned court be stayed till 31st January, 2026 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
7. Hence the matter to be listed on 20th January, 2026 for further hearing.
8. State is directed to furnish a report on the next date of hearing.
9. Accordingly, criminal revisional application being CRAN 1 of 2025 is disposed of.
10. Parties are to act on the server copy of this order downloaded from the official website of the Calcutta High Court.

(Chaitali Chatterjee (Das), J.)
